tests.protocol: All 25 tools registered with side-effect annotations; in-process protocol workflows and a real stdio subprocess talking to a real local HTTP server passed.
tests.package: Built wheel and sdist; extracted wheel independently registered 25 tools and completed compile/download/render with controlled HTTP.
tests.lint_and_format: ruff check and format checks passed

live_scope: Validated supplied web session; credential values were not returned or copied into repository files.
Created one uniquely named dedicated project for the final pytest workflow.
A nonexistent root document produced a recorded failed request; ordinary compilation then succeeded.
Downloaded and validated PDF, rendered original page, read log/file tree/comments/history/labels, and validated a historical ZIP.
Compiled another version and confirmed downloading the older PDF did not rewind latest.
Deleted the dedicated test project in finally cleanup; final account check found zero remaining dedicated v2 test projects.
regressions: Server failure/statistical errors cannot be overridden by a log regex miss.
Cookies/CSRF never travel to configured CDN origins; unrelated output origins are rejected.
Invalid local or remote PDF, modified cached artifact, unsafe filename, symlink escape and unsafe ZIP are detected.
SQLite state survives restart; artifact updates, compile reservation, pinning and explicit cleanup are transactional.
Expired interrupted requests become unknown rather than being silently retried.
Local non-default Git branches are accepted with an explicit remote branch; remote URL passwords or token-like usernames are rejected.
Stable result snapshots and whole-JSON budgets include oversized record continuation.

auth.storage: Private local instance-bound file outside the repository, mode 0600

limitations: Web API observation does not certify atomic compilation of a requested Git commit. source_binding remains explicit and unverified.
This adapter does not expose an authoritative remote running/idle query; status reports local evidence and unknown outcomes.
Real Git clone/push was not tested; local Git binding and source-diff behavior were tested with real temporary repositories.
Live comment reads used a new project without preexisting collaborator comments; rich anchors/context were tested with controlled responses.
Overleaf web endpoints are not a stable public API; current request formats were checked against live responses and upstream source.
PDF visual comparison locates image changes, not scientific or editorial correctness.
